toolsPreview.name: send_calendar_invite
toolsPreview.description: Invite a person to a calendar event using only their phone number. They receive the invite as a text message; if they accept, their real email address is returned to the organizer (retrieve it with get_invite_status, or have it POSTed to your callback_url). US and Canada phone numbers only. You must attest that you have the recipient's consent to contact them about this event.

toolsPreview.name: get_invite_status
toolsPreview.description: Check whether a sent invite has been accepted or declined, and retrieve the recipient's revealed email once they have accepted. Returns one of: sent, accepted, declined, failed. The revealed email is null until the recipient accepts and provides it.
